boarded-measured-region-review#3.acceptance: Not a visual pass. No threshold waiver, masking recommendation, fake chrome, guessed implementation cause, or pixel-derived corrective value. Correctable navigation deviations must be separated from unavoidable native-chrome differences before any further parity decision.
